title: servedev.json
description: A repo's dev servers and shared profiles, for servedev (https://github.com/servedev/servedev). Shared with everyone who clones the repo; JSON with comments.

servers.description: Server name -> how to run it.

command.description: Shell command. {port} is replaced by the assigned port; $PORT is set too.

setup.description: Runs before the command on every start, e.g. "pnpm install".

cwd.description: Folder to run in, relative to the project (the folder with servedev.json).

port.description: A port number, or "auto" for a free one.

env.description: Variables for the server. Put secrets in an .env file the app reads, not here.

ready.description: When the server counts as ready. Default: once it listens on a TCP port.

oneOf.description: "none": as soon as it spawns (workers, watchers).

log.description: Regex matched against the log, e.g. "ready in".

url.description: URL or path (e.g. "/health") that must answer with a status < 500.

timeout.description: Seconds to wait until ready (default 60, or 300 with a setup step).

hostname.description: Custom hostname served by servedev's proxy, e.g. "web.localhost".

profiles.description: Shared profiles: sets of this repo's servers started together. Everyone can pick their own accounts, skip servers and arrange the grid on top, in their own config.

servers.description: Server names from "servers", in start order.

accounts.description: What the servers need, without anyone's identity, e.g. {"gcloud": {"project": "acme-dev"}}. Personal accounts (emails) belong in each person's own config.

i.description: The server (a name in servedev.json; an id like "project:name" in config.json).

w.description: Width in columns (a normal tile is 6).

h.description: Height in rows (a normal tile is 9).

grid.description: Default dashboard grid (tiles by server name).
